warnings: Keep Braintree Auth distinct from generic transaction authorization and preserve this guide's connected-merchant OAuth and Node.js server-side scope.

Retain all three `state` conditions together: non-guessable submission, returned-value matching and proper escaping; do not reduce the route to a generic CSRF mention.
Keep exact option values, signup field inventories and linked-guide behavior in raw rather than expanding the concept into a replacement specification.
